usageNotes: Use this to define a named, cluster-wide USB device mapping so VMs can reference a logical ID rather than node-specific hardware paths. The caller must hold the Mapping.Modify privilege on /mapping/usb. Each entry in the map array ties a cluster node to the physical USB device identifiers (vendor/product ID or device path) on that node.

examples.summary: Create a USB mapping for a Yubikey hardware token available on two nodes

params.description: Yubico YubiKey 5 NFC - shared auth token for privileged VMs

tips: The id field must be a valid pve-configid (alphanumeric and hyphens, no spaces); choose a name that reflects the device purpose rather than a hardware identifier.
Each map entry must name at least one cluster node; nodes not listed will not expose the mapping to VMs scheduled on them.
After creation, assign the mapping to a VM via the VM's hardware config (usb0: mapping=<id>); the mapping itself does not attach anything automatically.
Returns null on success — confirm creation by calling get_cluster_mapping_usb_id or listing mappings with get_cluster_mapping_usb.
